cases.disposition_reason: jackin --scenario returning --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120×40. workspaces in src/bin/jackin/domain/fixtures.rs enables acct-claude-work on payments-platform and sets role_preferred for reviewer and Anthropic to that id. It does not set accounts.preferred. acct-claude-personal is Anthropic, display name Personal, and default_for_provider is true. acct-claude-work is display name Work and is not the provider default. effective_accounts in src/bin/jackin/domain/workspace.rs marks the inherited default preferred when no workspace preferred id is stored. Account::title in src/bin/jackin/domain/account.rs joins the surface name and the display name. UsageSurface::surface_name in src/bin/jackin/domain/agent.rs is Claude for Anthropic, and Provider::short is Anthropic. render_accounts in src/bin/jackin/screens/editor.rs paints the display name, [✓] or [ ], and ★ when preferred. Effective::label is inherited default or enabled here. One Down from Current directory focuses payments-platform. Key e calls Go::Editor in src/bin/jackin/screens/manager.rs. ] in src/bin/jackin/screens/editor.rs moves General to Mounts, Roles, Environments, and then Accounts. The Personal row is [✓], contains inherited default, and contains ★. The Work row is [✓], contains enabled here, and does not contain ★. Esc calls leave in editor.rs. change_count is 0, so Unsaved changes stays closed. Ctrl+Q exits 0. No account policy is stored.
cases.entry_path: jackin --scenario returning --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40; Down to payments-platform; e; ] four times
cases.return_path: Esc from a clean Accounts tab returns to the manager; Ctrl+Q exits 0

cases.disposition_reason: Reach Accounts the same way. The Personal row starts [✓] with inherited default and ★. The Work row starts [✓] with enabled here and no ★. Space on Personal calls accounts_key in src/bin/jackin/screens/editor.rs. Personal is the provider default, so disabled_defaults in src/bin/jackin/domain/workspace.rs gains acct-claude-personal and enabled loses it. The status is Claude · Personal · off for this Workspace · the global default stays registered, from Account::title in src/bin/jackin/domain/account.rs. The Personal row is [ ] and does not contain ★. p on the active Work row stores accounts.preferred for Anthropic. Provider::short in src/bin/jackin/domain/agent.rs is Anthropic, so the status is Preferred for Anthropic ★ Claude · Work. The Work row is [✓] and contains ★. The Personal row stays [ ] without ★. p is not sent to an inactive row, and the OpenAI rows are not changed. That list, before Ctrl+S, is the only checkpoint. The shot is 120×40, then 80×24, and the narrow shot is taken before the terminal returns to 120×40. Claude · Personal is not the starred account in either capture. Ctrl+S calls open_preview in src/bin/jackin/screens/editor.rs. The title is Save workspace. The focused line contains Cancel. Clean up & save… is absent. Confirm Save calls start_save, which schedules WorkspaceSaved at 900 ms, and the wall clock reaches Workspace payments-platform saved. No advance_clock. Reopening the editor Accounts tab shows Work [✓] with ★ and enabled here, and Personal [ ] without ★ and without inherited default. The fallback inherited default is not the preferred Anthropic account. The workspace name is still payments-platform.
cases.action_sequence: Disable the inherited Personal default, prefer Work, save, and reopen Accounts.
cases.expected_results: Work stays enabled and preferred. Personal stays off. The workspace name stays payments-platform.
cases.forbidden_effects: The inherited default stays the preferred Anthropic account.
